Operation.description: Represents an API operation inside the designer editor and agent model.

name.description: Unique identifier for the operation using dot-notation (e.g., 'product.getAll' or 'user.create').

description.description: Plain text summary explaining the purpose and behavior of this operation.

httpMethod.description: The HTTP method for this endpoint. Must be an uppercase verb: 'GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'PATCH', or 'HEAD'.

httpPath.description: The relative URL path of the endpoint. Path variables must be prefixed with a colon (e.g., '/product/:id').

httpCode.description: Default HTTP response status code for a successful request (e.g., '200', '201'). Defaults to '200' if omitted.

arguments.description: Ordered list of non-body input parameters (path, query, header) provided to this operation.

payload.description: The type name used as the request body payload. Defines the request body for POST/PUT/PATCH requests. Omit or leave empty for operations that do not require a request body (e.g., GET requests).

throws.description: List of non-success error responses that this operation can return.

return.description: The return type name or primitive type returned upon successful operation completion.

Operation_Argument.description: Represents a non-body input parameter (path, query, or header) passed to an operation.

name.description: Name of the argument. If 'in' is 'path', this must match the variable fragment in the httpPath (e.g., 'id' for '/product/:id').

in.description: Location of the argument in the HTTP request. Must be strictly one of: 'path', 'query', or 'header'. Do not use 'body' here, as request body payloads are defined using the operation 'payload' field.

type.description: Data type or type reference of the argument (e.g., 'string', 'integer', 'boolean', or a custom type name).

Operation_Throw.description: Represents an error response condition for an operation.

code.description: HTTP status code representing the error state (e.g., 400, 401, 404, 500).

type.description: Type name or model reference describing the error response body.

Document.description: Root document structure representing the complete API specification state.

operations.description: Array of API operations defined in this specification.
